text: Based on the evidence, the statement is **misleading and generally false**. From low Earth orbit, the Great Wall is very difficult to distinguish with the naked eye: it is narrow and its color blends into the surrounding terrain. Exceptional viewing conditions may make parts of it detectable, but it is not conspicuously visible from space. It is certainly not visible from the Moon.
